title: Enoch's ascent and transformation into Metatron

tellings.quote: Enoch himself goes through this amazing personal transformation where he goes up to heaven, he walks with God, and then he turns into Medatron, this angel.
And it came to pass after this that his name during his lifetime was raised aloft to that Son of Man and to the Lord of Spirits from amongst those who dwell on the earth.
And he was raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit and his name vanished among them.

And it came to pass after this that my spirit was translated And it ascended into the heavens: And I saw the =holy sons of God=. They were stepping on flames of fire: Their garments were white [and their raiment], And their faces shone like snow.
And he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens, And I saw there as it were a structure built of crystals, And between those crystals tongues of living fire.
And I fell on my face, And my whole body became relaxed, And my spirit was transfigured; And I cried with a loud voice, with the spirit of power, And blessed and glorified and extolled.

plain: Enoch, a figure from the earliest chapters of the Bible, is said to have gone up to heaven alive and been turned into an angel named Metatron. Michels tells it himself, drawing on the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish book left out of most Bibles, in the translation R. H. Charles published in 1917. He says Enoch "goes up to heaven, he walks with God, and then he turns into Medatron, this angel", and he presents it as a man transformed by contact with something beyond. The Book of Enoch does tell of the ascent. Enoch was "raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit". In his own words, "he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens", where he saw "a structure built of crystals" with "tongues of living fire". There, "my whole body became relaxed, And my spirit was transfigured." Enoch becoming Metatron by name is told in 3 Enoch, a later Hebrew book from the Hekhalot writings, a body of Jewish mystical texts about journeys to heaven. Going from this transfigured Enoch to the angel Metatron is that later book's step, which this one neither states nor rules out, and Michels tells it as if it came from the Book of Enoch.

discussion.by: The Book of Enoch (translated by R. H. Charles)
discussion.text: The Book of Enoch tells that Enoch was "raised aloft on the chariots of the spirit" (70:2); in his own words, "he translated my spirit into the heaven of heavens" (71:5), where "my whole body became relaxed, And my spirit was transfigured" (71:11). Enoch becoming the angel Metatron is told in 3 Enoch, a later Hebrew book of the Hekhalot literature; the step from the transfigured Enoch of this book to the angel Metatron is that later book's, which this book neither states nor excludes, and the teller tells it as the Book of Enoch's.
